sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园里发现了一具女尸。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血也被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达（Ada）。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是“罪案档案呈现”栏目推出的全新系列，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: It was between 9.30 and 10 o'clock when a small sports car slowly came to a stop on a gravel turnout, half a mile down the road from Lake Herman.
sentences.zh: 当时大约在九点半到十点之间，一辆小型跑车缓缓停在赫尔曼湖以南半英里处的一处碎石路肩上。

sentences.en: Behind the wheel was William Crowe.
sentences.zh: 坐在驾驶座上的是威廉·克劳（William Crowe）。

sentences.en: The car belonged to his girlfriend, who was riding beside him in the passenger seat.
sentences.zh: 这辆车属于他的女友，当时女友正坐在他身旁的副驾驶座上。

sentences.en: Although the car was new, it was having some troubles, so William had taken it for a cruise to test out the engine.
sentences.zh: 虽然这辆车是崭新的，但有些小故障，所以威廉开车兜风顺便测试发动机。

sentences.en: His route led him down Lake Herman Road, a five-mile stretch that curved through the countryside to the neighbouring city of Vallejo.
sentences.zh: 他的路线沿着赫尔曼湖路（Lake Herman Road）前行，这是一条五英里长的路段，蜿蜒穿过乡间，通往邻近的瓦列霍市（Vallejo）。

sentences.en: Traffic along Lake Herman Road was sparse during the day and near non-existent at night.
sentences.zh: 白天赫尔曼湖路上的车流量就很少，到了晚上几乎空无一人。

sentences.en: It was a lonely, quiet road framed by fields, trees and ranches that stretched over the rolling hills.
sentences.zh: 这是一条寂静偏僻的道路，两旁是田野、树木和农场，延伸至起伏的丘陵。

sentences.en: With no streetlights to illuminate the scenery, the area had become a lover's lane of sorts.
sentences.zh: 由于没有路灯照明，这个地区在某种程度上成了约会圣地。

sentences.en: Young couples seeking privacy would park their cars in the numerous turnouts that lined the road.
sentences.zh: 寻求隐私的年轻情侣会将车停在路边众多的路肩上。

sentences.en: William Crowe pulled into one such turnout, situated at the gated number 10 entrance to the Benicia Water Pumping Station.
sentences.zh: 威廉·克劳将车驶入其中一个路肩，该路肩位于贝尼西亚水务泵站（Benicia Water Pumping Station）10号大门旁。

sentences.en: He positioned the car so that its rear faced the gate and the headlights illuminated the road.
sentences.zh: 他调整了车位，让车尾对着大门，车头灯照亮道路。

sentences.en: Soon, his attention was drawn to a growing light.
sentences.zh: 很快，一束逐渐变亮的光吸引了他的注意。

sentences.en: A vehicle was travelling down Lake Herman Road towards Vallejo.
sentences.zh: 一辆汽车正沿着赫尔曼湖路朝瓦列霍方向驶来。

sentences.en: It rolled along in the pitch-black darkness until it reached the gate number 10 turnout.
sentences.zh: 它在一片漆黑中缓缓行驶，直到抵达10号大门的路肩。

sentences.en: William's headlights swept over the car as it passed and he caught a quick glimpse of the driver.
sentences.zh: 当它驶过时，威廉的车灯扫过了这辆车，他迅速瞥了一眼司机。

sentences.en: He was male, with short hair and glasses.
sentences.zh: 是个男的，留着短发，戴着眼镜。

sentences.en: The car itself was a light-coloured, four-door Chevrolet Impala, a classic late 1950s model with a hardtop and tail fin.
sentences.zh: 这辆车本身是一辆浅色的四门雪佛兰英帕拉（Chevrolet Impala），一款带有硬顶和尾鳍的1950年代后期经典车型。

sentences.en: The Chevy had barely cleared the turnout when it stopped abruptly in the middle of the road.
sentences.zh: 这辆雪佛兰刚过路肩就在路中间突然停了下来。

sentences.en: Its taillights lit up and it began reversing.
sentences.zh: 它的尾灯亮起，开始倒车。

sentences.en: Something about this sudden move made William uneasy.
sentences.zh: 这个突然的举动让威廉感到有些不安。

sentences.en: He immediately felt compelled to leave, so he drove back onto Lake Herman Road and headed in the opposite direction of the Chevy, towards Benicia.
sentences.zh: 他立刻萌生了离开的念头，于是将车开回赫尔曼湖路，朝着与雪佛兰相反的方向——贝尼西亚驶去。

sentences.en: Keeping an eye on the rear-view mirror, William watched the Chevy reverse into the turnout.
sentences.zh: 威廉通过后视镜注视着那辆雪佛兰倒车进入路肩。

sentences.en: Within seconds, it turned around, rolled back onto Lake Herman Road and sped up until it was right behind William.
sentences.zh: 几秒钟内，它调头重新开上赫尔曼湖路，并加速直到紧贴着威廉的车尾。

sentences.en: The Chevy's driver then started flashing his high beaMs.
sentences.zh: 随后，雪佛兰的司机开始闪烁远光灯。

sentences.en: William was tempted to pull over and confront the driver, but his terrified girlfriend convinced him not to.
sentences.zh: 威廉本想把车停下跟对方理论，但在他惊恐女友的劝说下打消了念头。

sentences.en: Instead, he sped up to create some distance between the two vehicles.
sentences.zh: 相反，他加速拉开两车之间的距离。

sentences.en: The other driver matched his speed and then some.
sentences.zh: 对方司机不仅跟上了他的速度，甚至还更快。

sentences.en: William glanced back.
sentences.zh: 威廉回头瞥了一眼。

sentences.en: The Chevy's right front fender was closing in on the sports car's rear quarter panel.
sentences.zh: 雪佛兰的右前翼子板正在逼近跑车的右后侧围板。

sentences.en: Irritation turned to dread as William shifted to a lower gear and slammed the gas pedal to the floor.
sentences.zh: 随着威廉换入低速挡并把油门踩到底，烦躁感瞬间变成了恐惧。

sentences.en: Up ahead was a fork in the road.
sentences.zh: 前方是一个分岔路口。

sentences.en: The Chevy remained hot on William's tail as he sped towards it.
sentences.zh: 威廉加速冲过去时，雪佛兰依然紧咬不放。

sentences.en: Waiting until the very last moment, William gave the steering wheel a sharp turn, sending his car flying down the turn off.
sentences.zh: 直到最后一刻，威廉猛地打方向盘，让车子飞驰着拐下了路口。

sentences.en: The Chevy, far too heavy to make such a tight turn so quickly, barrelled onwards.
sentences.zh: 雪佛兰车身太重，无法如此迅速地完成急转弯，只能继续向前冲去。

sentences.en: After travelling 200 yards, William braked to a stop.
sentences.zh: 行驶了200码后，威廉踩刹车停了下来。

sentences.en: He turned to look back towards the intersection and was shocked to see the Chevy sitting idle in the middle of Lake Herman Road.
sentences.zh: 他转过头向十字路口望去，震惊地发现那辆雪佛兰正停在赫尔曼湖路中央空转。

sentences.en: Burning with rage, William yelled expletives and threats in the direction of the other driver.
sentences.zh: 怒火中烧的威廉朝着对方司机大声咒骂并发出威胁。

sentences.en: The Chevy waited in the darkness, its engine quietly rumbling in response.
sentences.zh: 雪佛兰停在黑暗中，发动机低沉地轰鸣着以示回应。

sentences.en: After a short wait, the Chevy finally began to move.
sentences.zh: 稍作等待后，雪佛兰终于开始移动。

sentences.en: William watched nervously, his foot resting against the accelerator.
sentences.zh: 威廉紧张地注视着，脚踩在油门上。

sentences.en: The Chevy performed a U-turn and, to William's surprise, drove back towards Vallejo.
sentences.zh: 雪佛兰来了个U型掉头，令威廉吃惊的是，它又开回了瓦列霍方向。

sentences.en: The chase was over.
sentences.zh: 追逐结束了。

sentences.en: The impulse to go after the Chevy and face its driver was soon overwhelmed by the instinct to do the exact opposite.
sentences.zh: 想要追上去面对对方司机的冲动，很快就被做相反事情的本能所压倒。

sentences.en: Following his guard, William drove home.
sentences.zh: 听从内心的警惕，威廉开车回了家。

sentences.en: A short while later, a two-toned 1961 AMC Rambler station wagon pulled into the gravel turnout at Gate 10.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，一辆双色1961款AMC Rambler旅行车驶入了10号门的碎石路肩。

sentences.en: 17-year-old David Faraday had borrowed the car from his mother so he could take 16-year-old Betty Lou Jensen out for their first date.
sentences.zh: 17岁的戴维·法拉第（David Faraday）向母亲借了这辆车，带着16岁的贝蒂·露·詹森（Betty Lou Jensen）进行他们的第一次约会。

sentences.en: The pair had recently met while serving on a decorating committee for an upcoming music festival.
sentences.zh: 两人最近在为即将到来的音乐节筹备装饰委员会时相识。

sentences.en: David was the quintessential, good-natured, all-American youth who split his spare time between the Eagle Scouts and his high school wrestling team.
sentences.zh: 戴维是个典型的、善良的美国好青年，他的业余时间分别贡献给了雄鹰童子军（Eagle Scouts）和高中摔跤队。

sentences.en: Betty Lou, a popular student at a neighbouring school, was smitten.
sentences.zh: 贝蒂·露是邻校的一名受欢迎的学生，她已经深深迷恋上了他。

sentences.en: By December 20 1968, Betty Lou had only known David for one week, but all signs pointed to him becoming her first boyfriend.
sentences.zh: 到1968年12月20日，贝蒂·露认识戴维仅仅一周，但种种迹象表明他将成为她的初恋男友。

sentences.en: At 8 o'clock that night, David arrived at the Jensen house to formally meet Betty Lou's parents.
sentences.zh: 当晚8点，戴维来到詹森家，正式拜访贝蒂·露的父母。

sentences.en: After he'd made a good impression, the teens left, with David promising to have Betty Lou home by 11.
sentences.zh: 留下了良好的印象后，两个年轻人便出门了，戴维承诺在11点前送贝蒂·露回家。

sentences.en: The teens were cutting it close to curfew when they parked at the turnout at around 10.15.
sentences.zh: 两人在大约10点15分把车停在路肩时，时间已经逼近了宵禁。

sentences.en: Reclining in their seats, Betty Lou rested her head on David's shoulder and looked out the windshield at the darkened fields to the eaSt.
sentences.zh: 他们靠在座椅上，贝蒂·露把头靠在戴维的肩膀上，透过挡风玻璃望着东面黑暗的田野。

sentences.en: She had never been on a date before, but the fact they'd ended up on Lake Herman Road meant that things were going well.
sentences.zh: 她以前从未约会过，但他们最终停在赫尔曼湖路上，意味着事情进展得很顺利。

sentences.en: They had the turnout to themselves, with only the occasional car passing by, and the teens soon lost track of time.
sentences.zh: 路肩只有他们一辆车，偶尔有车驶过，两个年轻人很快就忘记了时间。

sentences.en: It was minutes after 11pm when their solitude was disturbed by a bright light.
sentences.zh: 晚上11点过几分，一束耀眼的光线打破了他们的宁静。

sentences.en: It was emanating from a pencil-sized flashlight that was taped to the barrel of a handgun.
sentences.zh: 光线来自一支用胶带固定在手枪枪管上的铅笔大小的手电筒。

sentences.en: A male's voice ordered Betty Lou and David to get out.
sentences.zh: 一个男人的声音命令贝蒂·露和戴维下车。

sentences.en: When the teenagers failed to follow his order, he started firing.
sentences.zh: 见这两个年轻人没有照做，他便开枪了。

sentences.en: One bullet ricocheted off the roof above the rambler's back passenger door.
sentences.zh: 一颗子弹从Rambler车后乘客门上方的车顶反弹开去。

sentences.en: Another punctured the left rear wheel well.
sentences.zh: 另一颗子弹击穿了左后轮拱。

sentences.en: The third pierced the right rear window, causing the glass to crack.
sentences.zh: 第三颗子弹击碎了右后车窗，导致玻璃破裂。

sentences.en: These were just warning shots.
sentences.zh: 这些都只是警告射击。

sentences.en: Now Betty Lou and David did as they were told.
sentences.zh: 这下贝蒂·露和戴维照办了。

sentences.en: A frightened Betty Lou unlocked her door and stepped into the cold night.
sentences.zh: 惊恐万分的贝蒂·露解开她的车门，走进了寒冷的夜色中。

sentences.en: David followed closely behind, scrambling over the bench seat from the driver's side.
sentences.zh: 戴维紧随其后，从驾驶座那边翻过长凳座椅爬了过来。

sentences.en: He had barely lifted himself out when the gun was pressed to his head and its trigger was pulled.
sentences.zh: 他刚探出身子，一把枪就顶住他的头，扳机扣动了。

sentences.en: David tumbled from the car and fell on his back by the rambler's rear wheel.
sentences.zh: 戴维从车里栽了下来，仰面倒在Rambler的车后轮旁。

sentences.en: Betty Lou sprinted towards the road.
sentences.zh: 贝蒂·露朝大路飞奔而去。

sentences.en: The shooter raised his weapon and fired off six quick shots.
sentences.zh: 凶手举起武器，连续开了六枪。

sentences.en: One bullet flew right by her.
sentences.zh: 一颗子弹从她身旁呼啸而过。

sentences.en: The rest burrowed into the right side of her back, causing her to collapse onto her side a few strides shy of the road.
sentences.zh: 其余的子弹击中了她右侧背部，导致她在距离大路仅几步之遥的地方侧身倒下。

sentences.en: With both teams down, the attacker fled.
sentences.zh: 眼见两人都倒下了，袭击者逃跑了。

sentences.en: He didn't pass Stella Borges, who was driving along Lake Erman Road to pick her son up from a movie theatre in Benicia.
sentences.zh: 他没有碰上斯特拉·博尔赫斯（Stella Borges），当时她正驾车行驶在赫尔曼湖路上，准备去贝尼西亚的一家电影院接儿子。

sentences.en: It was approaching 11.15pm when Stella reached the gravel turnout leading to the water pumping station.
sentences.zh: 斯特拉到达通往水泵站的碎石路肩时，时间已接近晚上11点15分。

sentences.en: As she navigated the turn, her car's headlights swept across the area, illuminating a tan-coloured station wagon.
sentences.zh: 当她转弯时，汽车的车灯扫过该区域，照亮了一辆棕褐色的旅行车。

sentences.en: It sat alone in the dark, its passenger side door wide open.
sentences.zh: 它孤零零地停在黑暗中，副驾驶座的车门大敞着。

sentences.en: A young man was lying on the ground.
sentences.zh: 一个年轻男子正躺在地上。

sentences.en: Stella's stomach lurched.
sentences.zh: 斯特拉胃里一阵翻江倒海。

sentences.en: Then she saw the body of a young woman sprawled closer to the road.
sentences.zh: 接着，她看到一具年轻女性的尸体瘫倒在离大路更近的地方。

sentences.en: Too frightened to pull over, Stella sped onwards to Benicia.
sentences.zh: 由于过于害怕而不敢停车，斯特拉加速向贝尼西亚驶去。

sentences.en: She turned down East 2nd Street and spotted a police cruiser in the distance.
sentences.zh: 她拐入东二街（East 2nd Street），隐约看到远处有一辆警车。

sentences.en: Desperate to get the officer's attention, Stella frantically honked her horn and flashed her headlights.
sentences.zh: 为了引起警察的注意，斯特拉拼命按喇叭并闪烁大灯。

sentences.en: Word of Stella's discovery spread quickly, with police and paramedics converging at the turnout.
sentences.zh: 斯特拉发现尸体的消息迅速传开，警察和急救人员纷纷涌向路肩。

sentences.en: As they approached the body of Betty Lou Jensen, it became clear she was deceased.
sentences.zh: 当他们靠近贝蒂·露·詹森的遗体时，确认她已经死亡。

sentences.en: Lying closer to the rambler was David Faraday.
sentences.zh: 躺在离Rambler更近的是戴维·法拉第。

sentences.en: As officers moved in, they noticed a fleeting, misty cloud escape David's lips.
sentences.zh: 当警察靠近时，他们注意到戴维的嘴唇边呼出一团转瞬即逝的雾气。

sentences.en: He was still breathing.
sentences.zh: 他还活着。

sentences.en: He was rushed to hospital, but died along the way.
sentences.zh: 他被紧急送往医院，但在途中身亡。

sentences.en: Hours earlier, David Faraday had marched across the grounds of Hogan High School, where Betty Lou was an honour roll student.
sentences.zh: 几个小时前，戴维·法拉第曾穿过霍根高中（Hogan High School）的校园，贝蒂·露曾是那里的荣誉生。

sentences.en: But David wasn't looking for Betty Lou.
sentences.zh: 但戴维并不是来找贝蒂·露的。

sentences.en: Witnesses watched as the typically mild-mannered David confronted 16-year-old Richard Burton.
sentences.zh: 目击者看到一向温和的戴维质问16岁的理查德·伯顿（Richard Burton）。

sentences.en: The pair exchanged some heated words, though they were discreet enough not to draw the attention of any nearby teachers.
sentences.zh: 两人激烈地争吵了几句，不过他们还算谨慎，没有引起附近老师的注意。

sentences.en: Fearful that he'd soon be spotted and get in trouble, David left before the altercation became physical.
sentences.zh: 由于担心被发现惹上麻烦，戴维在冲突升级为肢体冲突前离开了。

sentences.en: Word of this confrontation reached detectives investigating David's murder.
sentences.zh: 这场冲突的消息传到了调查戴维谋杀案的侦探耳中。

sentences.en: They visited Hogan High, where they examined Betty Lou's locker.
sentences.zh: 他们走访了霍根高中，检查了贝蒂·露的储物柜。

sentences.en: In her binder for English class, they found a note she had written.
sentences.zh: 在她的英语课文件夹里，他们发现了一张她写的便条。

sentences.en: Do you know a kid named Richard Burton, it read.
sentences.zh: 上面写着：“你认识一个叫理查德·伯顿的孩子吗？”

sentences.en: I was going with him until two days before the installation.
sentences.zh: “我和他在一起过，直到装置安装前两天。”

sentences.en: He still phones me and is threatening me to keep away from Dave.
sentences.zh: “他还经常给我打电话，威胁我离戴维远点。”

sentences.en: He said that if he's ever close enough to Dave, he would punch him one in the teeth.
sentences.zh: “他说如果哪天离戴维足够近，他就要一拳打碎戴维的牙齿。”

sentences.en: I told him to leave me alone, if he knows what's good for him.
sentences.zh: “我告诉他识相点的话就别来烦我。”

sentences.en: Police were familiar with Richard Burton, who was also known as Ricky.
sentences.zh: 警方对理查德·伯顿并不陌生，他也被叫做瑞奇（Ricky）。

sentences.en: He was currently on probation for stealing.
sentences.zh: 他当时正因盗窃处于缓刑期。

sentences.en: An outsider with few friends, Ricky was often seen walking the school halls with Betty Lou and was rumoured to be pursuing a relationship with her.
sentences.zh: 作为一个没什么朋友的局外人，瑞奇经常被看到和贝蒂·露一起走在学校走廊里，有传言称他一直在追求她。

sentences.en: When Betty Lou started seeing David, Ricky was jealous.
sentences.zh: 当贝蒂·露开始和戴维交往时，瑞奇嫉妒了。

sentences.en: He'd been harassing her ever since, sometimes calling her house every 15 minutes.
sentences.zh: 此后他一直骚扰她，有时每隔15分钟就往她家打电话。

sentences.en: Betty Lou was convinced Ricky was spying on her and advised her sister and mother to keep the curtains closed at all times.
sentences.zh: 贝蒂·露确信瑞奇在监视她，并劝告她的姐姐和母亲随时拉紧窗帘。

sentences.en: On several occasions, they'd found the side gate to their house mysteriously open.
sentences.zh: 有好几次，他们发现家里的侧门莫名其妙地开着。

sentences.en: Although they had no evidence to prove it, the Jensen family suspected Ricky might have been prowling around.
sentences.zh: 虽然没有证据证明，但詹森一家怀疑瑞奇可能一直在附近徘徊。

sentences.en: The evening before she was killed, Betty Lou confided in her sister Melody that she was afraid of Ricky.
sentences.zh: 遇害前一天晚上，贝蒂·露向姐姐梅洛迪（Melody）吐露，她很害怕瑞奇。

sentences.en: He had threatened to tell Betty Lou's parents some of her secrets, such as the fact that she was a smoker and had started a relationship with David.
sentences.zh: 他威胁要把贝蒂·露的一些秘密告诉她的父母，比如她抽烟以及开始和戴维谈恋爱的事。

sentences.en: Ricky had also threatened to beat David up using brass knuckles.
sentences.zh: 瑞奇还威胁要用指节铜套痛打戴维一顿。

sentences.en: Melody advised Betty Lou to beat Ricky to it and tell their parents about David herself.
sentences.zh: 梅洛迪建议贝蒂·露先发制人，自己把戴维的事告诉父母。

sentences.en: Betty Lou followed her sister's advice and introduced her parents to David before they left for their date.
sentences.zh: 贝蒂·露听取了姐姐的建议，在他们出门约会前将戴维介绍给了父母。

sentences.en: When questioned, Ricky said the last time he'd spoken to Betty Lou was around 4.30pm on Thursday December 19.
sentences.zh: 接受讯问时，瑞奇说他最后一次和贝蒂·露说话是在12月19日星期四下午4点半左右。

sentences.en: He hadn't been at school that day, so he'd called her at home to see if there was anything he'd missed.
sentences.zh: 他那天没去学校，所以打电话到她家，看有没有落下什么功课。

sentences.en: He denied exchanging heated words with David on the day of the murders and insisted he'd never made any threats to David's face.
sentences.zh: 他否认在谋杀案当天与戴维发生过激烈争吵，并坚称自己从未当面威胁过戴维。

sentences.en: Ricky was surprised but not upset to hear about the note Betty Lou had written about him.
sentences.zh: 听到贝蒂·露写下关于他的便条时，瑞奇感到惊讶但并不难过。

sentences.en: Ricky maintained he was home all night when David and Betty Lou were attacked.
sentences.zh: 瑞奇坚称戴维和贝蒂·露遇袭时他整晚都在家。

sentences.en: It was his sister's birthday, and the family ate cake and watched a movie together until 11pm.
sentences.zh: 那天是他姐姐的生日，一家人一起吃蛋糕看电影，直到晚上11点。

sentences.en: Ricky said he went to bed at around 11.30 and learned of the shootings the following day.
sentences.zh: 瑞奇说他大约11点30分上床睡觉，第二天得知了枪击事件。

sentences.en: His parents confirmed his alibi.
sentences.zh: 他的父母证实了他的不在场证明。

sentences.en: They explained that Ricky wasn't allowed out after 9pm and even if he was, he didn't have access to a car.
sentences.zh: 他们解释说瑞奇晚上9点以后不允许出门，即便能出门，他也没有车开。

sentences.en: His mother had a Maroon Pontiac Grand Prix, but Ricky wasn't permitted to drive it.
sentences.zh: 他母亲有一辆栗色庞蒂亚克大奖章（Pontiac Grand Prix），但瑞奇不准开车。

sentences.en: Nor did he have access to a gun.
sentences.zh: 他也无法接触到枪支。

sentences.en: Detectives accepted Ricky's alibi as ironclad, but didn't cross him off the list completely.
sentences.zh: 侦探们认为瑞奇的不在场证明无懈可击，但并没有将他完全排除在嫌疑人名单之外。

sentences.en: As the new year approached, they explored a different theory.
sentences.zh: 随着新年临近，他们探讨了另一种理论。

sentences.en: The crime scene had yielded few clues.
sentences.zh: 犯罪现场几乎没有留下什么线索。

sentences.en: The night of the murders was cold at just 22 degrees Fahrenheit and the ground had frozen solid.
sentences.zh: 谋杀当晚天气寒冷，温度仅有华氏22度，地面已经冻结。

sentences.en: This meant there were no traceable shoe or tyre prints at the turnout.
sentences.zh: 这意味着路肩上没有留下可追踪的鞋印或轮胎印。

sentences.en: Neither victim was robbed.
sentences.zh: 两名受害者都没有被抢劫。

sentences.en: There was no sign of sexual assault.
sentences.zh: 没有性侵的迹象。

sentences.en: A struggle hadn't taken place.
sentences.zh: 这里没有发生过搏斗。

sentences.en: It was all so needless, detectives thought.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是那么毫无意义，侦探们想。

sentences.en: They began to consider the possibility that the crime was carried out by a motiveless, murderous maniac who didn't know David or Betty Lou.
sentences.zh: 他们开始考虑这样一种可能性：这起罪行是由一个不认识戴维或贝蒂·露的、毫无动机的杀人狂魔所为。

sentences.en: 10 .22 caliber long rifle bullet casings were found around the Rambler, stamped with the Winchester Super X brand logo.
sentences.zh: 在Rambler周围发现了10枚.22口径长步枪子弹壳，上面印有温彻斯特超级X（Winchester Super X）品牌标志。

sentences.en: The majority of the casings were scattered on the ground by the passenger side, indicating that after the killer shot David Faraday, he either ordered Betty Lou to run,
sentences.zh: 大部分弹壳散落在副驾驶座旁边的地上，这表明在凶手枪杀戴维·法拉第后，他要么命令贝蒂·露逃跑，

sentences.en: or she did so instinctively, while he fired at her.
sentences.zh: 要么就是她本能地逃跑了，而他则向她开枪。

sentences.en: As Sheriff Sargent explained to the press, quote,
sentences.zh: 正如萨金特警长（Sheriff Sargent）向媒体解释的那样，引述如下：

sentences.en: The killer needed no artificial lighting in shooting the girl, since she was running on a plateau and her body was silhouetted against the sky.
sentences.zh: “凶手在枪击这个女孩时不需要任何人工照明，因为她在高原上奔跑，她的身体在天空的衬托下形成了剪影。”

sentences.en: While the type of gun used in the shooting was unknown, microscopic analysis of the spent bullets determined they were likely fired from a handgun, possibly a J.C.
sentences.zh: 虽然枪击中使用的枪支类型尚不清楚，但对用过的子弹进行的显微分析确定，它们很可能是由手枪发射的，可能是一把J.C.

sentences.en: Higgins Model 80, a high standard Model 101, or some other semi-automatic pistol.
sentences.zh: 一把希金斯80型、高标101型或其他半自动手枪。

sentences.en: Locals were willing to cooperate with authorities, surrendering their guns for testing.
sentences.zh: 当地居民愿意配合当局，主动交出枪支进行测试。

sentences.en: Of those handed in, all were ruled out as the murder weapon.
sentences.zh: 在交出的枪支中，全部被排除是凶器。

sentences.en: With little evidence to go on, investigators had to rely heavily on witness recollections.
sentences.zh: 由于缺乏线索，调查人员不得不严重依赖目击者的回忆。

sentences.en: This wasn't ideal, given that human memory is inconsistent and easily influenced, but they didn't have much choice.
sentences.zh: 考虑到人类的记忆前后不一且易受影响，这并不是理想的方法，但他们别无选择。

sentences.en: Although no one had seen the shooting, several people had passed through the area, enabling detectives to put together a relatively accurate timeline.
sentences.zh: 尽管没人目击枪击过程，但有几个人曾经过该地区，这让侦探们得以拼凑出相对准确的时间线。

sentences.en: It was through these witness statements that a crucial clue finally emerged.
sentences.zh: 正是在这些目击者的证词中，一个关键线索终于浮出水面。

sentences.en: Before David and Betty Lou arrived at the gate tent turnout, a suspicious vehicle was seen cruising up and down Lake Herman Road, intermittently pulling in and out of the turnout.
sentences.zh: 在大卫和贝蒂·露到达赫尔曼湖路边帐篷调头区之前，有人看到一辆可疑车辆在赫尔曼湖路上来回游荡，断断续续地驶入和驶出调头区。

sentences.en: Descriptions of its make, model and colour varied, as it had been too dark for anyone to get a good look.
sentences.zh: 对其品牌、型号和颜色的描述各不相同，因为天色太暗，没人能看清。

sentences.en: Some thought it was white, while others said cream, blue or grey.
sentences.zh: 有人认为是白色的，也有人说是乳白色、蓝色或灰色。

sentences.en: The number of occupants seen inside varied, but a late 50s Chevrolet Impala appeared in three independent witness reports, including that of William Crow,
sentences.zh: 车内人数的说法不一，但三名独立的目击者报告中都出现了50年代末的雪佛兰黑斑羚轿车，其中包括威廉·克劳，

sentences.en: who claimed it had chased him from the turnout just over an hour before David and Betty Lou were killed.
sentences.zh: 他声称在大卫和贝蒂·露遇害前一个多小时，这辆车一直在调头区追赶他。

sentences.en: Had William and his girlfriend crossed paths with the killer and managed to elude him, forcing him to find a new target.
sentences.zh: 威廉和他的女友是否与凶手狭路相逢并成功摆脱了他，从而迫使他寻找新的目标？

sentences.en: Witness James Owen was the only person who drove by the turnout around the time of the shooting.
sentences.zh: 目击者詹姆斯·欧文是枪击发生前后唯一开车经过该调头区的人。

sentences.en: He was on his way to work the night shift at his job in Benicia when he passed the gate 10 and saw the Faraday family's rambler.
sentences.zh: 他当时正开车去贝尼西亚上班上夜班，路过10号闸口时看到了法拉第一家的旅行车。

sentences.en: James didn't take much notice of this car, only noting that it was mid-sized, lacking in chrome finishes, and was a dark colour.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯没怎么注意这辆车，只记它是中等大小、没有镀铬装饰、颜色较深。

sentences.en: James said he didn't see anyone in or near either vehicle, but described hearing a gunshot once he was a quarter mile down the road.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯说他没有看到任何车内或车旁有人，但描述说当他开出四分之一英里远时听到了一声枪响。

sentences.en: While James Owen's statement seemed significant, it wasn't particularly reliable.
sentences.zh: 虽然詹姆斯的证词似乎很重要，但并不是特别可靠。

sentences.en: Whatever the case, neither the owner of the vehicle James allegedly witnessed, nor that of the Chevy Impala, came forward to police.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，无论是詹姆斯目击的那辆车的车主，还是雪佛兰黑斑羚的车主，都没有向警方自首。

sentences.en: Sixteen miles north of Vallejo, in the city of Napa, 18-year-old Linda heard a knock at her front door.
sentences.zh: 在瓦列霍以北十六英里的纳帕市，18岁的琳达听到有人敲前门。

sentences.en: Her husband, 20-year-old Larry, was working the night shift at a nearby gas station, leaving Linda home alone.
sentences.zh: 她的丈夫、20岁的拉里正在附近的一家加油站上夜班，留下琳达独自在家。

sentences.en: She peered outside and saw a man in his late 20s standing there.
sentences.zh: 她向外望去，看到一个二十多岁的男子站在那儿。

sentences.en: He was about 5 foot 11 with black hair and an acne-scarred face.
sentences.zh: 他身高约5英尺11英寸，留着黑发，脸上长满青春痘疤痕。

sentences.en: Linda recognised him right away.
sentences.zh: 琳达一眼就认出了他。

sentences.en: It was Pete, a former neighbour who had once lived in the same apartment complex as the couple.
sentences.zh: 他是皮特，一个以前和这对夫妇住在同一个公寓大楼的前邻居。

sentences.en: Pete hadn't been inside for long when he abruptly asked Linda,
sentences.zh: 皮特进屋没多久，就突然问琳达：

sentences.en: What would you do if I raped you?
sentences.zh: 如果我强奸你，你会怎么做？

sentences.en: Linda was terrified.
sentences.zh: 琳达吓坏了。

sentences.en: She knew that Pete carried a fishing knife in his pocket and also possessed a rifle and a handgun.
sentences.zh: 她知道皮特的口袋里装着一把钓鱼刀，还拥有一支步枪和一把手枪。

sentences.en: Without missing a beat, Linda replied that she would bang on the wall and her neighbour would phone the police.
sentences.zh: 琳达毫不迟疑地回答说，她会砸墙，邻居就会报警。

sentences.en: Undeterred by this response, Pete asked Linda if she was happy.
sentences.zh: 皮特对这个回答不以为然，问琳达她过得开心吗。

sentences.en: She replied that she was.
sentences.zh: 她回答说她很开心。

sentences.en: Happy people piss me off, Pete complained.
sentences.zh: 开心的人真让我火大，皮特抱怨道。

sentences.en: He began telling Linda how he'd been arguing with his wife and how all the people in his new neighbourhood were stabbing him in the back.
sentences.zh: 他开始向琳达倾诉自己如何与妻子吵架，以及新社区的所有人如何暗中捅他刀子。

sentences.en: He'd decided to go south to Vallejo, or maybe Reading, a city 190 miles north.
sentences.zh: 他决定往南去瓦列霍，或者去190英里以北的雷丁市。

sentences.en: Linda did her best to remain calm.
sentences.zh: 琳达竭力保持冷静。

sentences.en: When Pete finally left 45 minutes later, she could hear someone walking around outside, but didn't look to see who it was.
sentences.zh: 45分钟后皮特终于离开时，她能听到外面有人走动的声音，但没有去看是谁。

sentences.en: Linda subsequently told Larry about the distressing encounter.
sentences.zh: 琳达随后把这次令人不安的遭遇告诉了拉里。

sentences.en: He was shaken.
sentences.zh: 他感到十分震惊。

sentences.en: Pete had visited him at work about 15 minutes before heading over to the couple's home, as though checking to make sure Linda would be alone.
sentences.zh: 皮特在前往这对夫妇家之前大约15分钟曾在工作单位拜访过他，就像是为了确认琳达是否独自在家一样。

sentences.en: The couple reported the incident to police.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇向警方报了案。

sentences.en: Pete's mention of Vallejo and the fact he owned multiple firearms seemed suspicious in the wake of David Faraday and Betty Lou Jensen's murders exactly one week earlier.
sentences.zh: 就在大卫·法拉第和贝蒂·露·詹森遇害整整一周后，皮特提到瓦列霍以及他拥有多支枪支的事实显得十分可疑。

sentences.en: Neither Linda nor Larry could recall Pete's surname, but they knew he drove a blue 1952 Chevrolet Coupe and also owned a cream and maroon Buick.
sentences.zh: 琳达和拉里都想不起皮特的姓氏，但他们知道他开一辆蓝色的1952年雪佛兰轿跑车，还拥有一辆乳白色和栗色相间的别克。

sentences.en: Pete was just one of many suspicious individuals to emerge in the Faraday Jensen murder investigation.
sentences.zh: 皮特只是法拉第和詹森谋杀案调查中涌现的众多可疑人员之一。

sentences.en: An unidentified prowler in a blue car who roamed Benicia at night was another, and investigators also examined suspects from other violent crimes.
sentences.zh: 另一个是在夜间游荡于贝尼西亚的蓝色汽车里的不知名潜行者，调查人员还审查了其他暴力犯罪的嫌疑人。

sentences.en: Yet, as the weeks turned to months with no arrests, it seemed increasingly unlikely that the killer would be apprehended, and the case slowly faded from public attention.
sentences.zh: 然而，随着数周过去，几个月过去仍无逮捕消息，凶手被捕的可能性似乎越来越小，这起案件也渐渐淡出公众视野。

sentences.en: After questioning more than 100 people and amassing a four-inch thick case file, police were at a loss.
sentences.zh: 在盘问了100多人并积累了四英寸厚的案卷后，警方束手无策。

sentences.en: As were the victim's families, who collectively shook their heads during an interview with the Sunday Times Herald when asked if they had any idea who the killer was.
sentences.zh: 受害者的家属也是如此，在接受《星期日先驱时报》采访时，当被问及是否知道凶手是谁时，他们纷纷摇头。

sentences.en: Fearful the perpetrator might strike again, Betty Lou's father remarked,
sentences.zh: 由于担心凶手可能再次作案，贝蒂·露的父亲评论道：

sentences.en: I feel some nut is on the loose.
sentences.zh: 我觉得有个疯子在逍遥法外。

sentences.en: David's mother agreed, adding, And he'll find it easier the next time.
sentences.zh: 大卫的母亲表示赞同，并补充道：而且他下次下手会更容易。

sentences.en: The night of Friday July 4 1969, six months after the murders of David Faraday and Betty Lou Jensen, in Vallejo, California.
sentences.zh: 1969年7月4日星期五的夜晚，在大卫·法拉第和贝蒂·露·詹森遇害六个月后，加利福尼亚州瓦列霍。

sentences.en: It was close to midnight, and Independence Day celebrations were well underway all across the San Francisco Bay Area,
sentences.zh: 当时已近午夜，整个旧金山湾区的独立日庆祝活动正如火如荼地进行着，

sentences.en: when a man drove away from the festivities and fireworks, searching for someplace quiet.
sentences.zh: 一名男子驱车离开庆祝活动和焰火表演，寻找一个安静的地方。

sentences.en: He headed inland, where suburbia soon gave way to the peaceful countryside.
sentences.zh: 他朝内陆开去，那里的郊区景色很快被宁静的乡村所取代。

sentences.en: After passing Lake Herman Road, and the sprawling grounds of the Blue Rock Springs Park golf course,
sentences.zh: 在驶过赫尔曼湖路和蓝岩泉公园高尔夫球场的广阔场地后，

sentences.en: he pulled his car into an unsealed, unlit parking area, overshadowed by tree-covered hills.
sentences.zh: 他将车停在一个未铺路面、没有路灯、掩映在树木葱郁的山丘下的停车场里。

sentences.en: The area was deserted, with the exception of one other car.
sentences.zh: 除了另一辆车外，周围空无一人。

sentences.en: A brown, two-door 1963 Chevrolet Corvair faced the parklands, towards the southern corner of the lot.
sentences.zh: 一辆棕色双门1963年雪佛兰科维尔轿车面朝公园绿地，停在停车场南角。

sentences.en: Its engine and lights were off, but its radio was playing loudly.
sentences.zh: 它的发动机和车灯都熄灭了，但收音机开得很大。

sentences.en: Two figures were inside.
sentences.zh: 车里有两个身影。

sentences.en: They were a young couple, 22-year-old Darlene Farron, and her passenger, 19-year-old Michael Majo.
sentences.zh: 他们是一对年轻情侣，22岁的达伦·法伦和她的同乘者、19岁的迈克尔·马霍。

sentences.en: The pair had met at the restaurant where Darlene worked as a waitress and became close over the course of a few months.
sentences.zh: 两人在达伦打工做女服务员的餐厅相识，并在几个月的交往中变得亲密。

sentences.en: Darlene picked Michael up that night and had taken him to Blue Rock Springs Park because it was secluded.
sentences.zh: 达伦那天晚上接上迈克尔，把他带到了蓝岩泉公园，因为这里很偏僻。

sentences.en: She said there was something important she needed to tell him.
sentences.zh: 她说有件很重要的事情要告诉他。

sentences.en: Before long, their privacy was interrupted by the rumble of an engine and the sound of tyres crunching on loose gravel.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，他们的私密时光被发动机的轰鸣声和轮胎碾压松散碎石的声音打破了。

sentences.en: Another car rolled to a stop less than eight feet away from the Corvair's left side, where Darlene sat in the driver's seat.
sentences.zh: 另一辆车缓缓停下，距离达伦所在的驾驶座左侧不到八英尺。

sentences.en: The two cars were very similar in appearance, right down to the California license plates, though the Corvair's brown paint job was a slightly darker shade.
sentences.zh: 这两辆车外观非常相似，连加州车牌都一样，不过科维尔的棕色油漆颜色略深一些。

sentences.en: Darlene and Michael eyed the other car.
sentences.zh: 达伦和迈克尔打量着另一辆车。

sentences.en: Behind the steering wheel was a lone male.
sentences.zh: 方向盘后面坐着一个孤零零的男子。

sentences.en: He switched off his vehicle's headlights and sat silently in the dark.
sentences.zh: 他关掉了汽车大灯，在黑暗中静静地坐着。

sentences.en: Michael often teased Darlene about her wide circle of friends, so he jokingly asked if she knew the guy.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔经常取笑达伦的社交圈子很广，于是他开玩笑地问她是否认识这家伙。

sentences.en: Brushing him off, Darlene gave a vague reply.
sentences.zh: 达伦避而不谈，含糊地回答了一句。

sentences.en: Oh, never mind.
sentences.zh: 哦，没什么。

sentences.en: The mysterious stranger didn't stay long.
sentences.zh: 神秘的陌生人并没有待多久。

sentences.en: Within minutes, his car rumbled to life and he drove away.
sentences.zh: 几分钟内，他的汽车轰鸣着启动，开走了。

sentences.en: Five minutes later, he was back.
sentences.zh: 五分钟后，他又回来了。

sentences.en: This time, he parked about ten feet to the right of the Corvair.
sentences.zh: 这一次，他停在科维尔右侧约十英尺远的地方。

sentences.en: The man stepped outside, gripping the handle of a high-powered flashlight.
sentences.zh: 那人下了车，手里紧紧抓着一把强力手电筒的把手。

sentences.en: He walked up to the Corvair's open front passenger side window and aimed the flashlight directly into Michael and Darlene's eyes, blinding them.
sentences.zh: 他走到科维尔敞开的副驾驶侧前窗前，把手电筒直接照进迈克尔和达伦的眼睛，晃得他们睁不开眼。

sentences.en: Michael assumed the man was a police officer wondering what they were up to and reached for his ID.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔以为这人是个警察，想知道他们在干什么，便伸手去拿身份证。

sentences.en: As he did so, the man pulled out a pistol.
sentences.zh: 就在他这么做的时候，那人掏出了一把手枪。

sentences.en: Without saying a word, he began firing into the Corvair.
sentences.zh: 他一言不发地开始向科维尔车内开枪。

sentences.en: Michael was struck in the right arm.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔的右臂中枪。

sentences.en: Another bullet penetrated his right cheek, went through his tongue, out the left side of his neck, and into Darlene.
sentences.zh: 另一颗子弹击穿了他的右脸颊，穿过他的舌头，从左侧脖子射出，并射入了达伦体内。

sentences.en: The passenger side door handle was broken, preventing Michael from escaping the car.
sentences.zh: 副驾驶侧的车门把手坏了，导致迈克尔无法逃出车外。

sentences.en: He tried to scramble over into the back seat, but was halted by agonising pain as the shooter casually unloaded his pistol at him.
sentences.zh: 他试图艰难地爬到后座，但枪手若无其事地向他倾泻弹药时带来的剧痛阻止了他。

sentences.en: Then, just as quickly as it started, the shooting spree was over.
sentences.zh: 然后，枪击狂潮就像开始时一样突然结束了。

sentences.en: Darlene slumped against the steering wheel, bleeding from her arm, shoulder, chest, and back.
sentences.zh: 达伦瘫倒在方向盘上，手臂、肩膀、胸部和背部都在流血。

sentences.en: Michael had sustained similar wounds.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔也受了类似的伤。

sentences.en: The shooter began walking back to his car when he abruptly stopped, turned around, and marched back to the Corvair.
sentences.zh: 枪手正要走回自己的车时，突然停下脚步，转过身，大步走回科维尔车旁。

sentences.en: Unable to conceal his pain,
sentences.zh: 无法掩饰痛苦，

sentences.en: Michael Majo had let out an anguished yell, revealing that he was still alive.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·马霍发出一声痛苦的尖叫，暴露了自己还活着的事实。

sentences.en: Looking inside to where his victims lay bleeding, the man shot each of them once more.
sentences.zh: 男子朝车内望去，看着受害者躺在那里流血，又分别向两人各开了一枪。

sentences.en: Michael thrashed and was hit in the knee.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔挣扎着，膝盖中了一枪。

sentences.en: Darlene didn't react at all.
sentences.zh: 达伦没有任何反应。

sentences.en: Satisfied he'd finished what he started, the shooter drove away from the scene slowly, so as not to draw any attention to his car.
sentences.zh: 确信自己完成了未竟之事后，枪手缓缓驶离现场，以免引起对车辆的注意。

sentences.en: It was just after midnight when three teens arrived at Blue Rock Springs Park.
sentences.zh: 刚过午夜，三名青少年来到了蓝岩泉公园。

sentences.en: The trio had been driving around looking for a friend.
sentences.zh: 这三个人一直在开车寻找一个朋友。

sentences.en: Their search led them to the parking lot adjacent to the golf course, where they noticed a single vehicle in the southern corner shrouded in darkness.
sentences.zh: 他们的搜寻将他们带到了高尔夫球场旁边的停车场，在那里他们注意到南角停着一辆孤零零的汽车，隐没在黑暗中。

sentences.en: Its radio was blaring, but everything else was eerily quiet.
sentences.zh: 它的收音机震耳欲聋，但其他一切都死一般地寂静。

sentences.en: The teens paused, wondering if their friend was inside.
sentences.zh: 少年们停下脚步，纳闷他们的朋友是否在里面。

sentences.en: Suddenly, the car's headlights flicked on and a man's voice cried out.
sentences.zh: 突然，汽车的大灯闪了一下，一个男人的声音大喊起来。

sentences.en: The teens flashed their vehicle's high beams in response, illuminating a brown Chevrolet Corvair splattered with blood.
sentences.zh: 少年们见状闪了一下远光灯，照亮了一辆沾满血迹的棕色雪佛兰科维尔。

sentences.en: A young man tumbled out of the car and rioted on the ground.
sentences.zh: 一个年轻男子从车里跌跌撞撞地滚落到地上。

sentences.en: His black hair was a mess and his clothes were stained red.
sentences.zh: 他的黑发乱蓬蓬的，衣服被血染红了。

sentences.en: He pleaded for the teens to get help.
sentences.zh: 他恳求少年们去叫人帮忙。

sentences.en: Then he called out the name Darlene.
sentences.zh: 然后他喊出了达伦的名字。

sentences.en: A blonde woman sitting in the vehicle's driver's seat let out a pained moan in reply.
sentences.zh: 坐在车内驾驶座上的金发女郎痛苦地呻吟了一声作为回应。

sentences.en: The teens raised the alarm and police raced to the scene.
sentences.zh: 少年们拉响了警报，警察迅速赶往现场。

sentences.en: They found Michael Majo sprawled alongside the Corvair.
sentences.zh: 他们发现迈克尔·马霍四脚朝天地倒在科维尔旁边。

sentences.en: Still clinging to consciousness, he winced in pain as he told the officers he'd been shot.
sentences.zh: 他仍然保持着清醒，痛苦地抽搐着，告诉警察自己中枪了。

sentences.en: Darlene Ferran was still sitting behind the steering wheel.
sentences.zh: 达伦·费兰仍然坐在方向盘后面。

sentences.en: Her head was tilted and pressed against the driver's side window.
sentences.zh: 她的头歪向一边，紧紧贴在驾驶座侧的车窗上。

sentences.en: Her pulse was weak and her breathing was shallow.
sentences.zh: 她的脉搏微弱，呼吸急促浅表。

sentences.en: She tried to say something but was only able to utter the words, I or my, before passing out.
sentences.zh: 她试图说些什么，但只吐出“我”或“我的”这几个词，就昏迷过去了。

sentences.en: Half an hour later, at 12.40am, the phone rang at the Vallejo Police Department.
sentences.zh: 半小时后，即凌晨12点40分，瓦列HO警察局的电话响了。

sentences.en: Dispatcher Nancy Slova answered.
sentences.zh: 调度员南希·斯洛瓦接了电话。

sentences.en: A man on the other line immediately started talking.
sentences.zh: 电话那头的男子立刻开始说话。

sentences.en: I want to report a double murder, he stated matter-of-factly.
sentences.zh: 我要报告一起双重谋杀案，他语气平静地陈述道。

sentences.en: Nancy assumed he was a local or passer-by who'd overheard the goings-on at Blue Rock Springs Park.
sentences.zh: 南希以为他是个当地人或是路人，无意中听到了蓝岩泉公园发生的事情。

sentences.en: Police were already on scene, but she continued the call as per protocol and asked the man for his name and location.
sentences.zh: 警察已经赶到现场，但她按照规程继续通话，询问男子的姓名和位置。

sentences.en: He cut her off, speaking loudly over the top of her in a flat, unwavering manner, as though he'd rehearsed what he was going to say.
sentences.zh: 他打断了她的话，用平淡而坚定的语气大声盖过她的声音，就像排练过要说的话一样。

sentences.en: If you go to one mile east on Columbus Parkway to the public park, you will find the kids in a brown car.
sentences.zh: 如果你沿着哥伦布公园大道向东走一英里到公园，你会发现车里的那些孩子。

sentences.en: They were shot with a nine-millimeter luger.
sentences.zh: 他们是被九毫米鲁格手枪击中的。

sentences.en: The caller's tone shifted.
sentences.zh: 来电者的语调变了。

sentences.en: In a deeper, more taunting voice, he ended the call with the word,
sentences.zh: 用一种低沉、更具挑衅性的声音，他以一个词结束了通话：

sentences.en: Goodbye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Nancy tried to patch the call through to a desk officer, but the man hung up before she had the chance.
sentences.zh: 南希试图将电话转接到值班警官那里，但还没来得及，那名男子就挂断了电话。

sentences.en: She hadn't detected anything distinctive about his voice and didn't have the equipment to record the call.
sentences.zh: 她没有察觉到他声音有什么独特之处，也没有设备记录通话。

sentences.en: But it was able to be traced.
sentences.zh: 但这个电话是可以被追踪的。

sentences.en: Three officers rushed to the corner of Tuolumne Street and Springs Road in East Vallejo.
sentences.zh: 三名警官冲向瓦列霍东部的图奥勒米街和斯普林斯路的交汇处。

sentences.en: Their destination was a ten-minute drive from the crime scene via Columbus Parkway.
sentences.zh: 他们的目的地是通过哥伦布公园大道从犯罪现场驾车十分钟的车程。

sentences.en: Positioned on the street corner was Joe's Union Gas Station.
sentences.zh: 街角坐落着乔的联合加油站。

sentences.en: On the curb in front was a phone booth.
sentences.zh: 前面的马路牙子上有一个电话亭。

sentences.en: It was empty by the time police arrived.
sentences.zh: 警察到达时，里面空无一人。

sentences.en: Over at Blue Rock Springs Park, the search for evidence was turning up dry.
sentences.zh: 在蓝岩泉公园，搜寻证据的工作毫无进展。

sentences.en: Only two partial fingerprints were lifted from the Corvair's right-side door handle.
sentences.zh: 科维尔右侧车门把手上只提取到了两枚部分指纹。

sentences.en: The opposite problem arose with the phone booth.
sentences.zh: 电话亭则遇到了相反的问题。

sentences.en: It had far too many fingerprints, making it impossible to isolate any as belonging to the anonymous caller who'd claimed responsibility for the shooting.
sentences.zh: 那里的指纹实在太多了，根本无法分离出哪一枚属于宣称对枪击事件负责的匿名来电者。

sentences.en: At the time the call was placed, the gas station was closed, and no witnesses came forward to say they'd seen anyone at the payphone.
sentences.zh: 打电话时，加油站已经关门，也没有目击者站出来说他们看到有人在公用电话亭旁。

sentences.en: All police had to work with were seven 9mm bullet casings found on the right side of Darlene Ferrin's Corvair.
sentences.zh: 警方掌握的只有在达伦·费林的科维尔右侧发现的七枚9毫米子弹壳。

sentences.en: They were Western brand and fit Luger pistols, the gun the caller identified as being used in the shooting.
sentences.zh: 它们是西方品牌的，适用于鲁格手枪，也就是来电者指认的枪击案中使用的枪支。

sentences.en: What prompted the attack remained a mystery.
sentences.zh: 是什么引发了这次袭击仍然是个谜。

sentences.en: Darlene's handbag and Michael's wallet had not been taken.
sentences.zh: 达伦的手提包和迈克尔的钱包都没有被拿走。

sentences.en: There was no sign of sexual assault or a struggle.
sentences.zh: 没有性侵或搏斗的迹象。

sentences.en: Why the person believed to be responsible had phoned police in the aftermath of his crime was equally puzzling.
sentences.zh: 为什么被认为是凶手的人在犯案后会打电话给警察，同样令人费解。

sentences.en: It was clear from his manner of speaking that he wasn't apologetic, upset, or frightened.
sentences.zh: 从他的说话方式可以明显看出，他并不感到愧疚、心烦或害怕。

sentences.en: He hadn't tried to justify his crime or shift blame.
sentences.zh: 他没有试图为自己的罪行辩护或推卸责任。

sentences.en: All he wanted was to let the police know it was him.
sentences.zh: 他唯一想做的就是让警方知道那是他干的。

sentences.en: But, who was he?
sentences.zh: 但是，他是谁？

sentences.en: Within three hours of the shooting, a man arrived at the Vallejo Police Department inquiring about Darlene Ferrin.
sentences.zh: 枪击案发生三小时内，一名男子来到瓦列霍警察局打听达琳·费林的情况。

sentences.en: He had heard she'd been hurt and sought further information.
sentences.zh: 他听说她受伤了，想要了解更多信息。

sentences.en: The man was Darlene's husband, Dean.
sentences.zh: 这名男子是达琳的丈夫，迪恩。

sentences.en: He said he'd last seen Darlene at 10.30pm when she visited him at the restaurant where he worked as a chef.
sentences.zh: 他说自己最后一次见到达琳是在晚上10点半，当时她去他工作的餐馆探望他，他是一名厨师。

sentences.en: Although Darlene was alive when first responders arrived at Blue Rock Springs Park, she had died en route to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 尽管急救人员抵达蓝岩泉公园时达琳还活着，但她在送往医院的途中去世了。

sentences.en: When informed of his wife's outcome, Dean Ferrin crumpled to the floor sobbing.
sentences.zh: 得知妻子的噩耗时，迪恩·费林瘫倒在地，痛哭失声。

sentences.en: He was aware of his wife's close friendship with Michael Majo, but said he didn't harbour any animosity towards the young man over it.
sentences.zh: 他知道妻子与迈克尔·马约关系密切，但表示自己并没有因此对这个年轻人生恨。

sentences.en: While romantic rivalry, jealousy, heartbreak, or revenge all seemed like promising motives,
sentences.zh: 虽然浪漫纠葛、嫉妒、心碎或报复看起来都像是合理的动机，

sentences.en: Dean was at work when the shootings took place.
sentences.zh: 但枪击案发生时，迪恩正在上班。

sentences.en: Darlene's first husband, whom she'd divorced two years prior, was also ruled out.
sentences.zh: 达琳的前夫——两人两年前已离婚——也被排除嫌疑。

sentences.en: Uncovering a suspect from the victim's social circles proved difficult.
sentences.zh: 从受害者的社交圈中找出嫌疑人证明十分困难。

sentences.en: There was a general consensus among those who knew Darlene and Michael that neither had any enemies, nor were they in any trouble.
sentences.zh: 认识达琳和迈克尔的人普遍认为，两人既没有敌人，也没有惹上什么麻烦。

sentences.en: Two days after the shooting, investigators visited the Majo family home and spoke with Michael's loved ones, but left without any breakthroughs.
sentences.zh: 枪击案发生两天后，调查人员走访了马约一家的住所，与迈克尔的家属交谈，但没有取得任何突破就离开了。

sentences.en: Once they returned to the Vallejo police station, the phone rang.
sentences.zh: 他们一回到瓦列霍警察局，电话就响了。

sentences.en: On the other line was Stephen Majo, Michael's twin brother.
sentences.zh: 电话那头是迈克尔的孪生兄弟史蒂芬·马约。

sentences.en: Although he hadn't been able to think of anything significant when he spoke to detectives earlier, a disturbing memory had since emerged from the back of his mind.
sentences.zh: 虽然他之前与侦探交谈时想不出什么重要的事，但此后脑海深处浮现出一个令人不安的记忆。

sentences.en: It came with a name.
sentences.zh: 这伴随着一个名字。

sentences.en: George Waters.
sentences.zh: 乔治·沃特斯。

sentences.en: Months before she was killed,
sentences.zh: 在她被杀几个月前，

sentences.en: Darlene had told Stephen about an incident with a man named George Waters.
sentences.zh: 达琳曾向史蒂芬提起过她与一个叫乔治·沃特斯的男子之间的一次遭遇。

sentences.en: Stephen had initially dismissed Darlene's story, but since her murder, it had taken on a new significance.
sentences.zh: 史蒂芬最初对达琳的话不以为然，但自从她被害后，这件事有了新的意义。

sentences.en: Darlene revealed that Waters, who was known to pester her at work, had shown up at her home and broken in.
sentences.zh: 达琳透露，沃特斯经常在工作时纠缠她，甚至还去过她家并破门而入。

sentences.en: Once he was inside, he threatened to rape her.
sentences.zh: 他进去后，威胁要强奸她。

sentences.en: Darlene told Stephen that she managed to talk Waters out of hurting her.
sentences.zh: 达琳告诉史蒂芬，她设法劝说沃特斯放弃伤害她。

sentences.en: 29-year-old George Waters didn't have a criminal record, but he had a reputation at the restaurant where Darlene worked.
sentences.zh: 29岁的乔治·沃特斯没有犯罪前科，但他在达琳工作的餐馆里名声不太好。

sentences.en: He often teased Darlene, whom he referred to as Dee Dee.
sentences.zh: 他经常捉弄达琳，管她叫迪迪。

sentences.en: Darlene hated the nickname and often was riled up by George to the point of becoming angry.
sentences.zh: 达琳讨厌这个绰号，常常被乔治气得火冒三丈。

sentences.en: Up until about a month and a half earlier,
sentences.zh: 直到大约一个半月前，

sentences.en: George visited the eatery almost every night.
sentences.zh: 乔治几乎每天晚上都会光顾这家餐馆。

sentences.en: After that, the staff didn't see him anymore.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，员工们就再也没见过他。

sentences.en: Waters was taken in for questioning, where he admitted to teasing Darlene, but denied threatening or harming her in any way.
sentences.zh: 沃特斯被带去接受讯问，他承认自己捉弄过达琳，但否认曾威胁或伤害过她。

sentences.en: He maintained that he last saw her about six weeks prior, around the time others said he'd stopped visiting the restaurant.
sentences.zh: 他坚称自己最后一次见到她大约是在六周前，也就是其他人说他不再去餐馆的那段时间。

sentences.en: At the time, Waters observed that Darlene was quieter than usual, but their interaction was otherwise unremarkable.
sentences.zh: 当时，沃特斯注意到达琳比平时安静，但除此之外两人的互动并无异常。

sentences.en: As for his whereabouts on the night of July 4,
sentences.zh: 至于7月4日晚他的行踪，

sentences.en: Waters said he went to a fireworks display with his wife.
sentences.zh: 沃特斯说他和妻子去看了一场烟花表演。

sentences.en: They returned home at around 11pm and stayed there for the remainder of the night.
sentences.zh: 他们在晚上11点左右回家，并在那里待了整晚。

sentences.en: Waters denied having a gun or ever visiting Blue Rock Springs Park with Darlene.
sentences.zh: 沃特斯否认自己有枪，也否认曾与达琳去过蓝岩泉公园。

sentences.en: He owned three cars, none of which were deemed relevant to the case.
sentences.zh: 他拥有三辆车，但没有一辆被认为与本案有关。

sentences.en: As the investigation progressed, it seemed less and less likely that Darlene and Michael knew their assailant.
sentences.zh: 随着调查的深入，达琳和迈克尔认识凶手的可能性似乎越来越小。

sentences.en: Turning their attention elsewhere, investigators noticed that a peculiar figure seemed to appear in multiple tip-offs from the public.
sentences.zh: 调查人员将注意力转向其他地方，注意到公众的多条举报中似乎出现了一个奇怪的人物。

sentences.en: He was described as a heavyset white man with curly hair who drove a brown car.
sentences.zh: 据描述，他是一个体型魁梧、留着卷发的白人男子，开一辆棕色的车。

sentences.en: A man fitting this description allegedly approached a couple in Vallejo, saying he'd been involved in the shooting of two people and needed a ride to Santa Maria.
sentences.zh: 一名符合这一特征的男子据称在瓦列霍接近了一对情侣，声称自己卷入了一起两人枪击案，需要搭车去圣玛丽亚。

sentences.en: A similar man was named in an anonymous letter sent to the Vallejo Police Department, with the letter's author claiming he owned a suspicious vehicle and was, quote,
sentences.zh: 瓦列霍警察局收到的一封匿名信中也提到了一个类似的人，信件作者声称他拥有一辆可疑的车辆，并且，引述如下：

sentences.en: about 25, over 200 pounds, brownish thinning hair, sloppy, fat, and strange acting.
sentences.zh: 大约25岁，体重超过200磅，棕色稀疏头发，邋遢、肥胖且举止怪异。

sentences.en: But the most compelling witness statement regarding a curly-haired, heavyset man came from Michael Majo.
sentences.zh: 但关于这位卷发魁梧男子的最有力证词来自迈克尔·马约。

sentences.en: Although Darlene Ferron had succumbed to her injuries en route to the hospital,
sentences.zh: 尽管达琳·费林在送医途中因伤重不治身亡，

sentences.en: Michael miraculously survived following life-saving surgery.
sentences.zh: 但迈克尔在经历挽救生命的重大手术后奇迹般地活了下来。

sentences.en: Detectives visited his bedside as he recovered in hospital and were able to obtain a first-hand account of the shooting.
sentences.zh: 侦探们在他住院恢复时前往病床探视，并获取了关于枪击案的第一手叙述。

sentences.en: Michael described the shooter as a heavyset man with light curly hair, aged in his 20s.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔将枪手描述为一名20多岁、体型魁梧、留着浅色卷发的男子。

sentences.en: Case File will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《案情档案》稍后回归。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本集赞助商的节目来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本集的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Case File to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持《案情档案》继续提供高质量的内容。

sentences.en: An evening in February or March 1969, three to four months before Darlene Ferron was murdered.
sentences.zh: 1969年2月或3的一个傍晚，在达琳·费林遇害前三到四个月。

sentences.en: Karen stood at the window, her attention drawn to the street beyond.
sentences.zh: 卡伦站在窗前，注意力被外面的街道吸引了。

sentences.en: A lone male figure was sitting outside in a stationary white American sedan.
sentences.zh: 一辆停着的白色美国轿车里坐着一个孤独的男性身影。

sentences.en: Karen couldn't see much, only managing to catch a quick glimpse of the man whenever he lit a cigarette or switched on the vehicle's dome light.
sentences.zh: 卡伦看不清太多，只能在男子点烟或打开车顶灯时匆忙瞥上一眼。

sentences.en: Karen was a babysitter, and that night she was at the home of Darlene Ferron to look after her daughter.
sentences.zh: 卡伦是一名保姆，那天晚上她在达琳·费林家照顾她的女儿。

sentences.en: Darlene and her husband Dean were both out, and Karen had no idea who the stranger loitering outside their home was.
sentences.zh: 达琳和她的丈夫迪恩都外出了，卡伦根本不知道这个在他们家外面逗留的陌生人是谁。

sentences.en: He remained seated in the white car for about two hours.
sentences.zh: 他在那辆白车里坐了大约两个小时。

sentences.en: By the time Dean Ferron arrived home at around midnight, the car was gone.
sentences.zh: 午夜左右迪恩·费林回到家时，那辆车已经开走了。

sentences.en: When Karen returned to babysit again the following night, the presence of the strange car lingered in her mind.
sentences.zh: 第二天晚上卡伦再次来做保姆时，那辆陌生轿车的存在依然挥之不去地留在她脑海中。

sentences.en: She told Darlene about it while she applied her makeup in the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 她在卫生间化装时把这事告诉了达琳。

sentences.en: A look of fear flashed across Darlene's face.
sentences.zh: 一丝恐惧从达琳脸上闪过。

sentences.en: She said,
sentences.zh: 她说，

sentences.en: I guess he's checking up on me.
sentences.zh: 我想他是在监视我。

sentences.en: I heard that he was back from out of state.
sentences.zh: 我听说他从外地回来了。

sentences.en: He doesn't want anyone to know what I saw him do.
sentences.zh: 他不想让任何人知道我看到他做了什么。

sentences.en: I saw him murder someone.
sentences.zh: 我看到他谋杀了一个人。

sentences.en: Darlene had mentioned the man's name, but by the time investigators spoke to Karen in relation to Darlene's murder, her memory had faded.
sentences.zh: 达琳曾提过那个男人的名字，但当调查人员就达琳遇害一事找卡伦谈话时，她的记忆已经模糊了。

sentences.en: She believed the name was something short, maybe three or four letters long.
sentences.zh: 她认为那个名字很短，大概三四个字母长。

sentences.en: Darlene had also said that the man sometimes checked up on her at work.
sentences.zh: 达琳还说过，那个男人有时会在她上班时去视察她。

sentences.en: In the hopes of jogging Karen's memory, investigators arranged for her to see a hypnotiSt.
sentences.zh: 为了唤醒卡伦的记忆，调查人员安排她去看催眠师。

sentences.en: While Karen was still unable to remember the man's name, she recalled more of his physical features.
sentences.zh: 虽然卡伦依然想不起那个男人的名字，但她回想起了更多他的外貌特征。

sentences.en: He was white, middle-aged, with a heavyset build and a round face framed by dark brown curly hair.
sentences.zh: 他是白人，中年，体型魁梧，圆脸，周围环绕着深棕色卷发。

sentences.en: The heavyset suspect had re-emerged, but his identity remained a secret.
sentences.zh: 那个体型魁梧的嫌疑人再次出现，但他的身份仍然是个秘密。

sentences.en: Now it seemed Darlene had known her killer, and her chilling remark, I saw him murder someone, became a mystery in and of itself.
sentences.zh: 现在看来，达琳认识她的凶手，而她那句令人不寒而栗的话“我看到他谋杀了一个人”本身成了一个谜。

sentences.en: Just whose murder Darlene was referring to was unknown, but speculation ran rife.
sentences.zh: 达琳指的是谁的谋杀案尚不得而知，但各种猜测甚嚣尘上。

sentences.en: Three miles down the road from the Blue Rock Springs parking lot where Darlene was murdered was Lake Herman Road.
sentences.zh: 距离达琳遇害的蓝岩泉停车场三英里外就是赫尔曼湖路。

sentences.en: From there, it was a four-minute drive to the turnout of the gated number 10 entrance to the
sentences.zh: 从那里开车四分钟，就到了带有大门的10号入口岔道，

sentences.en: Benicia Water Pumping Station, where David Faraday and Betty Lou Jensen were gunned down six months earlier.
sentences.zh: 本尼西亚水务泵站，大卫·法拉第和贝蒂·露·延森六个月前在那里遭到枪杀。

sentences.en: When Vallejo Police dispatcher Nancy Slova received the call from an anonymous male taking
sentences.zh: 当瓦列霍警察局调度员南希·斯洛瓦接到一个宣称对蓝岩泉枪击案负责的匿名男子的电话时，

sentences.en: responsibility for the Blue Rock Springs shooting, he had made a chilling remark before hanging up.
sentences.zh: 他在挂断电话前说了一句令人毛骨悚然的话。

sentences.en: After providing key information about his attack against Darlene and Michael, he added, I also killed those kids last year.
sentences.zh: 在提供关于他袭击达琳和迈克尔的关键信息后，他补充道：“我去年还杀了那些孩子。”

sentences.en: The similarities between the Faraday Jensen and the Faraday Majo shootings were obvious to investigators the moment they arrived at the Blue Rock Springs Park.
sentences.zh: 调查人员一到达蓝岩泉公园，法拉第·延森案与法拉第·马约案之间的相似之处就显而易见了。

sentences.en: A young couple, a remote location with a water-based name, a handgun, lack of a motive or suspects, the randomness of the attack.
sentences.zh: 年轻的情侣，带有水名的偏远地点，手枪，缺乏动机或嫌疑人，袭击的随机性。

sentences.en: While the caller could have been lying, investigators were open to the possibility that the same offender had gunned down all four victiMs.
sentences.zh: 虽然打电话的人可能在撒谎，但调查人员对同一罪犯枪杀所有四名受害者的可能性持开放态度。

sentences.en: In the aftermath of the Blue Rock Springs Park shooting, an anonymous letter was sent to the case detectives.
sentences.zh: 蓝岩泉公园枪击案发生后，一封匿名信寄给了案件侦探。

sentences.en: It cast suspicion on the occupant of a house near Lake Herman, right near where David and
sentences.zh: 这封信将怀疑指向赫尔曼湖附近的一所房子里的人，就在大卫和

sentences.en: Betty Lou were killed.
sentences.zh: 贝蒂·露被杀的地方正附近。

sentences.en: According to the nameless source, a 22-year-old man named Charles lived there, and he was, quote,
sentences.zh: 据这个无名消息源称，那里住着一个22岁名叫查尔斯的男子，他，引述如下：

sentences.en: Off balance by things that he has done in the past, and very capable of committing the murders in that area and at Blue Rock.
sentences.zh: 因过去所做的事情而心神不宁，非常有可能在该地区和蓝岩犯下谋杀案。

sentences.en: Lead detective on the Faraday Majo case, Sergeant John Lynch, arrived at the north shore of Lake
sentences.zh: 法拉第·马约案的首席侦探约翰·林奇中士来到了赫尔曼湖北岸，

sentences.en: Herman on the lookout for the suspect's house.
sentences.zh: 搜寻嫌疑人的房子。

sentences.en: Interestingly, Charles had a criminal history.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，查尔斯有犯罪前科。

sentences.en: Detective Lynch had already tried calling the phone number police had on file for him, but the line was disconnected.
sentences.zh: 林奇侦探已经试过拨打警方记录在案的他的电话号码，但该号码已经停机。

sentences.en: So the detective decided to seek Charles out in person.
sentences.zh: 因此侦探决定亲自去找查尔斯。

sentences.en: His house shouldn't have been hard to find, given it had a unique characteristic.
sentences.zh: 鉴于它有一个独特的特征，他的房子应该不难找到。

sentences.en: It was pink.
sentences.zh: 它是粉红色的。

sentences.en: Eventually, Lynch spotted the pink property.
sentences.zh: 最终，林奇发现了那处粉红色的房产。

sentences.en: It looked as though it belonged to a caretaker and stood alone, with no other houses nearby for several hundred yards.
sentences.zh: 它看起来像是一个看守人的住所，孤零零地矗立着，方圆几百码内没有其他房屋。

sentences.en: Lynch approached the building, only to discover it was padlocked shut.
sentences.zh: 林奇走近建筑物，却发现它被挂锁锁上了。

sentences.en: Lynch peered inside.
sentences.zh: 林奇往里面张望。

sentences.en: The house was clearly vacant.
sentences.zh: 房子显然是空的。

sentences.en: As detectives for both murder investigations sifted through an array of suspects known to
sentences.zh: 正当两起谋杀案的侦探在受害者熟知的众多嫌疑人中筛查时，

sentences.en: the victims, it was never far from their mind that the person they were looking for was not a jilted classmate or crush.
sentences.zh: 他们始终清醒地认识到，他们寻找的人不是一个被抛弃的同学或暗恋对象。

sentences.en: He was a serial killer.
sentences.zh: 他是一个连环杀手。

sentences.en: On Thursday, July 31, 1969, almost one month after the Blue Rock Springs Park shooting, a strange
sentences.zh: 1969年7月31日星期四，即蓝岩泉公园枪击案发生近一个月后，一个奇怪的

sentences.en: envelope arrived at the editorial department of the San Francisco Chronicle newspaper.
sentences.zh: 信封送达了旧金山纪事报报社的编辑部。

sentences.en: It was postmarked from the San Francisco area and featured no address, just the name of the newspaper, followed by the message,
sentences.zh: 它的邮戳来自旧金山地区，没有地址，只有报纸的名称，随后附带信息：

sentences.en: A curious editor glanced at the envelope before opening it.
sentences.zh: 一位好奇的编辑在打开信封前瞥了一眼。

sentences.en: Inside was a double-sided, handwritten letter, riddled with spelling mistakes and grammatical errors.
sentences.zh: 里面是一封双面手写信，充满了拼写错误和语法错误。

sentences.en: It read,
sentences.zh: 上面写着：

sentences.en: Dear editor,
sentences.zh: 亲爱的编辑，

sentences.en: This is the murderer of the two teenagers last Christmas at Lake Herman and the girl on the 4th of July near the golf course in Vallejo.
sentences.zh: 这是去年圣诞节在赫尔曼湖杀害两名青少年的凶手，也是7月4日在瓦列霍高尔夫球场附近杀害那个女孩的凶手。

sentences.en: To prove I killed them, I shall state some facts which only I and the police know.
sentences.zh: 为了证明是我杀的，我将陈述一些只有我和警方知道的事实。

sentences.en: At Christmas
sentences.zh: 圣诞节

sentences.en: Brand name of ammo, Super X
sentences.zh: 弹药品牌，Super X

sentences.en: Ten shots were fired
sentences.zh: 开了十枪

sentences.en: The boy was on his back with his feet to the car
sentences.zh: 男孩仰面躺着，脚朝向汽车

sentences.en: The girl was on her right side, feet to the west
sentences.zh: 女孩右侧卧，脚朝西

sentences.en: 4th of July
sentences.zh: 7月4日

sentences.en: Girl was wearing patterned slacks
sentences.zh: 女孩穿着有花纹的休闲裤

sentences.en: The boy was also shot in the knee
sentences.zh: 男孩的膝盖也被枪击了

sentences.en: Brand name of ammo was Western
sentences.zh: 弹药品牌是Western

sentences.en: Here is part of a cipher
sentences.zh: 这是一段密码的一部分

sentences.en: The other two parts of this cipher are being mailed to the editors of the Vallejo Times and
sentences.zh: 这段密码的另外两部分正在寄往瓦列霍时报和

sentences.en: San Francisco Examiner.
sentences.zh: 旧金山考察报的编辑手中。

sentences.en: I want you to print this cipher on the front page of your paper.
sentences.zh: 我希望你们将这段密码印在报纸头版。

sentences.en: In this cipher is my identity.
sentences.zh: 我的身份就在这密码里。

sentences.en: If you do not print this cipher by the afternoon of Friday 1st of August 69, I will go on a kill rampage
sentences.zh: 如果你们不在69年8月1日星期五下午之前印出这密码，我将在周五晚上

sentences.en: Friday night.
sentences.zh: 开启疯狂杀戮。

sentences.en: I will cruise around all weekend killing lone people in the night, then move on to kill again, until I end up with a dozen people over the weekend.
sentences.zh: 我整个周末都会到处游荡，在夜里杀害孤身一人的人，然后继续杀戮，直到这个周末结束时杀够十几个人。

sentences.en: Beneath this final line was a hand-drawn illustration of a crosshair circle, similar to a gun sight.
sentences.zh: 在这最后一行下方，手绘着一个准星圆圈的插图，类似于枪支瞄准器。

sentences.en: It appeared the author was taking credit for the December 1968 murders of David Faraday and Betty Lou Jensen,
sentences.zh: 看来这位作者是在为1968年12月大卫·法拉第和贝蒂·露·延森的谋杀案邀功，

sentences.en: as well as the more recent attack against Michael Majo and Darlene Farron.
sentences.zh: 以及最近针对迈克尔·马约和达琳·法林的袭击。

sentences.en: The cipher he referred to was drawn on a smaller sheet of paper.
sentences.zh: 他提到的密码画在一张较小的纸上。

sentences.en: It displayed a series of 136 characters organized into 8 neat rows and 17 columns.
sentences.zh: 它展示了一系列136个字符，排列成8个整齐的行和17个列。

sentences.en: They ranged from letters of the alphabet to less familiar symbols and shapes, such as mathematical signs, naval figures,
sentences.zh: 它们的范围从英文字母到不太熟悉的符号和形状，例如数学符号、海军图形，

sentences.en: and the same crosshair that the author had used to sign off his letter.
sentences.zh: 以及作者用来签署信件的同一个准星。

sentences.en: Across town and in nearby Vallejo, near-identical notes arrived at the editorial departments of the San Francisco Examiner and the Vallejo Times-Herald.
sentences.zh: 在城市的另一端以及附近的瓦列霍，几乎完全相同的便条送达了旧金山考察报和瓦列霍时报先驱报的编辑部。

sentences.en: They also contained additional portions of the cryptogram.
sentences.zh: 它们还包含密码的其余部分。

sentences.en: With all three combined, the cipher featured a total of 408 characters, which led to it being dubbed the 408.
sentences.zh: 这三个密码结合起来，总共有408个字符，因此被称为“408密码”。

sentences.en: Police examined each letter for latent fingerprints and sent copies of the cipher to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 警方对每封信件进行了潜在指纹检查，并将密码副本发送给了美国

sentences.en: Navy radio station cryptographic unit.
sentences.zh: 海军无线电台密码学单位。

sentences.en: All they could deduce was that the writer may have been involved with the Navy and was possibly formally trained in encryption.
sentences.zh: 他们唯一能推断出的是，写信人可能与海军有关，并且可能受过正式的加密培训。

sentences.en: Editors at all three newspapers debated whether or not to print the cipher as instructed.
sentences.zh: 三家报社的编辑都在争论是否按照指示刊登这个密码。

sentences.en: Some felt the public had a right to know that a murderer was threatening to go on a killing spree.
sentences.zh: 有些人觉得公众有权知道凶手威胁要进行疯狂杀戮。

sentences.en: However, they were reluctant to succumb to a criminal's demands or cause unnecessary public distress,
sentences.zh: 然而，他们又不愿意屈服于罪犯的要求或引起不必要的公众恐慌，

sentences.en: as the city's headlines were already dominated by other violent crimes and the turbulent Vietnam War.
sentences.zh: 因为当时城市的头条新闻已经被其他暴力犯罪和动荡的越南战争所主导。

sentences.en: On the other hand, the cipher had a greater chance of being solved if more people could examine it.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，如果有更多人能检查这个密码，它被破解的可能性就会更大。

sentences.en: The editors finally decided to publish the cryptogram, but refused to meet the author's demands regarding the deadline or front page spot.
sentences.zh: 编辑们最终决定发表这个密码电报，但拒绝满足作者关于截止日期或头版位置的要求。

sentences.en: The San Francisco Examiner also ran an article pointing out that investigators couldn't be certain of the author's guilt until he disclosed more details about the crimes.
sentences.zh: 《旧金山纪事报》也发表了一篇文章指出，在凶手透露更多关于犯罪的细节之前，调查人员无法确定其罪行。

sentences.en: On August 4, a three-page letter arrived at the San Francisco Examiner.
sentences.zh: 8月4日，一封三页的信件送达《旧金山纪事报》。

sentences.en: It began,
sentences.zh: 信中开头写道：

sentences.en: In answer to your asking for more details about the good times I have had in Vallejo, I shall be very happy to supply even more material.
sentences.zh: “为了回答你们要求提供更多我在瓦列乔度过美好时光的细节，我非常乐意提供更多的材料。”

sentences.en: By the way, are the police having a good time with the code?
sentences.zh: “顺便问一句，警方觉得这个密码好玩吗？”

sentences.en: If not, tell them to cheer up.
sentences.zh: “如果没有，告诉他们振作起来。”

sentences.en: When they do crack it, they will have me.
sentences.zh: “等他们破解了，就能抓到我了。”

sentences.en: As the newspaper requested, the author gave more details about the crimes, including some that hadn't been released to the public.
sentences.zh: 正如报纸所要求的，作者提供了更多关于犯罪的细节，包括一些未向公众公布的内容。

sentences.en: He pointed out things that detectives were wrong about,
sentences.zh: 他指出了侦探们弄错的地方，

sentences.en: like their assertion to the press that he would have been able to see Betty Lou Jensen's silhouette as she ran across the turnout.
sentences.zh: 比如他们向媒体断言，当贝蒂·洛·詹森跑过岔路时，他能够看到她的剪影。

sentences.en: Bullshit, he wrote.
sentences.zh: “胡说八道，”他写道。

sentences.en: That area is surrounded by high hills and trees.
sentences.zh: “那个地区周围都是高山和树木。”

sentences.en: He corrected them by explaining that he'd actually attached a small flashlight to his gun in order to see his targets better in the dark.
sentences.zh: 他纠正了他们的说法，解释说他实际上在枪上安装了一个小型手电筒，以便在黑暗中更好地看清目标。

sentences.en: He also took responsibility for the disturbing phone call that dispatcher Nancy Slover received at the Vallejo Police Department, which he described as
sentences.zh: 他还承认了瓦列乔警察局调度员南希·斯洛弗接到的一通令人不安的电话，他将此描述为

sentences.en: Having some fun with the Vallejo cops.
sentences.zh: “和瓦列乔警察开个玩笑。”

sentences.en: The letter concluded,
sentences.zh: 信的结尾是：

sentences.en: I was not happy to see that I did not get front page coverage, followed by the same hand-drawn crosshair symbol featured on the previous letter.
sentences.zh: “看到自己没有登上头版，我很不高兴，”随信附上了前一封信中出现的手绘十字准星符号。

sentences.en: The San Francisco Examiner published an article about the latest letter and included a lengthy excerpt.
sentences.zh: 《旧金山纪事报》发表了一篇关于这封最新信件的文章，并收录了其中的长篇节选。

sentences.en: Due to the author's self-introduction, the police, media, and public finally had a name for the perpetrator.
sentences.zh: 由于作者的自我介绍，警方、媒体和公众终于给这个凶手起了一个名字。

sentences.en: From this point on, he was known as the Zodiac Killer.
sentences.zh: 从这一刻起，他被称为“十二宫杀手”。

sentences.en: Many people seemed to fit the Zodiac characterisation in some capacity.
sentences.zh: 许多人似乎在某种程度上符合十二宫的特征。

sentences.en: A troubled young man named David was reported after his former foster mother realised he'd been in Vallejo for his brother's funeral at the time of David Faraday and Betty Lou Jensen's murders.
sentences.zh: 一个名叫大卫的陷入困境的年轻人在前养母意识到他在大卫·法拉第和贝蒂·洛·詹森谋杀案发生时去瓦列乔参加他兄弟的葬礼后被举报。

sentences.en: While there, he'd been gifted a firearm that had belonged to his brother.
sentences.zh: 在那期间，他曾获赠一把属于他兄弟的火器。

sentences.en: A .22 calibre rifle.
sentences.zh: 一支.22口径的步枪。

sentences.en: Most notably of all, when David was upset, he would soothe himself by creating cryptograMs.
sentences.zh: 最引人注目的是，大卫心烦意乱时，会通过创作密码来慰藉自己。

sentences.en: Some of these were passed along to detectives for examination, but they deemed David an unlikely suspect.
sentences.zh: 其中一些密码被转交给侦探进行检查，但他们认为大卫不太可能是嫌疑人。

sentences.en: A wife reported her ex-husband, as he was known to sign his letters with a crosshair-like symbol.
sentences.zh: 一名妻子举报了她的前夫，因为他习惯用类似十字准星的符号在信件上签名。

sentences.en: Another suspect came to light after a couple received a letter from a distant relative, claiming he was a killer for the mafia and needed help.
sentences.zh: 另一名嫌疑人的出现是因为一对夫妇收到了一封来自远房亲戚的信，声称他是黑手党的杀手，需要帮助。

sentences.en: The letter was sent for handwriting analysis, with fingerprints lifted and compared to the partial prints on file.
sentences.zh: 这封信被送去进行笔迹分析，提取指纹并与档案中的部分指纹进行比对。

sentences.en: He was ruled out of the investigation.
sentences.zh: 他被排除在调查之外。

sentences.en: Many suspects were interviewed simply because those who reported them thought they had acted strangely and or they owned a gun.
sentences.zh: 许多嫌疑人接受盘问只是因为举报他们的人认为他们的行为很奇怪或者他们拥有一支枪。

sentences.en: While each person varied in intrigue, the actual killer eluded investigators.
sentences.zh: 尽管每个人的疑点各不相同，但真正的凶手还是避开了调查人员。

sentences.en: 41-year-old Donald Harden was a history and economics teacher from the Californian city of Salinas.
sentences.zh: 41岁的唐纳德·哈登是加利福尼亚州萨利纳斯市的一名历史和经济学教师。

sentences.en: In his spare time, he liked to create amateur cryptograMs.
sentences.zh: 在业余时间，他喜欢创作业余密码。

sentences.en: He and his wife Betty had seen the Zodiac Killer's 408 cipher published in the newspapers and decided to try to solve it.
sentences.zh: 他和妻子贝蒂在报纸上看到了十二宫杀手的408密码，并决定尝试破解它。

sentences.en: Their first move was to figure out which symbol might represent the letter E, the most commonly used letter in the English language.
sentences.zh: 他们的第一步是找出哪个符号可能代表字母E，这是英语中最常用的字母。

sentences.en: However, the killer had apparently anticipated this approach and deliberately used 12 different symbols to signify E, to thwart would-be codebreakers.
sentences.zh: 然而，凶手显然预料到了这种方法，故意使用了12个不同的符号来表示E，以阻挠潜在的破译者。

sentences.en: Donald and Betty considered the matter for a while, then tried a different tack.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德和贝蒂考虑了一会儿，然后尝试了另一种策略。

sentences.en: They figured the author had likely used the word kill more than once, so they began looking for four-letter patterns that would fit with this.
sentences.zh: 他们认为作者很可能不止一次使用过“kill”这个词，于是开始寻找与之匹配的四个字母的模式。

sentences.en: For 20 hours, they painstakingly chipped away at the code.
sentences.zh: 在20个小时里，他们煞费苦心地攻克这个密码。

sentences.en: Finally, they cracked it.
sentences.zh: 终于，他们破解了。

sentences.en: The decoded message read,
sentences.zh: 解码后的信息写道：

sentences.en: The best part of it is that when I die, I will be reborn in paradise, and all the people I have killed will become my slaves.
sentences.zh: “最棒的部分是，当我死后，我将在天堂重生，我杀过的人都将成为我的奴隶。”

sentences.en: I will not give you my name, because you will try to slow down or stop my collecting of slaves for my afterlife.
sentences.zh: “我不会把我的名字告诉你，因为你会试图放慢或阻止我为来世收集奴隶。”

sentences.en: Following this was a garbled string of 18 letters that couldn't be deciphered using the code.
sentences.zh: 随之而来的是一串18个无法用该密码破译的杂乱字母。

sentences.en: Donald suspected that a separate method would be needed to unravel this final sentence, and that it might hold the key to the Zodiac's identity.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德怀疑需要一种单独的方法来解开这最后一句，这可能掌握着十二宫身份的钥匙。

sentences.en: He sent the decoded message to the San Francisco Chronicle, along with several sheets of paper that he'd scribbled his work notes on.
sentences.zh: 他将解码后的信息以及几张写满工作笔记的纸张发送给《旧金山纪事报》。

sentences.en: The newspaper's editors received the documents on August 8, and immediately notified Vallejo Detective Sergeant John Lynch.
sentences.zh: 报社编辑于8月8日收到这些文件，并立即通知了瓦列乔警探中士约翰·林奇。

sentences.en: Detective Lynch raced up to San Francisco to collect the letter and worksheets.
sentences.zh: 林奇警探赶往旧金山收集信件和工作表。

sentences.en: As he cast his eyes over the decoded message, he was hit by a wave of disappointment.
sentences.zh: 当他浏览解码后的信息时，一阵失望感涌上心头。

sentences.en: He'd hoped it would contain specific information about the killer's identity.
sentences.zh: 他曾希望其中能包含有关凶手身份的具体信息。

sentences.en: The message was also sent to the president of the American Cryptogram Association, who agreed with Donald's translation.
sentences.zh: 该信息还被发送给美国密码协会会长，他赞同唐纳德的翻译。

sentences.en: To him, it was clear that the person who had created the cipher was extremely adept at designing codes.
sentences.zh: 在他看来，很明显，制造这个密码的人非常擅长设计代码。

sentences.en: The biggest clue in the message was the killer's description of humans as the most dangerous animal of all.
sentences.zh: 信息中最具轰动性的线索是凶手将人类描述为“最危险的动物”。

sentences.en: This was likely a reference to a short story titled The Most Dangerous Game, in which a character kills people for sport after growing bored with hunting animals.
sentences.zh: 这很可能是指一篇名为《最危险的游戏》的短篇小说，其中一个角色在对猎取动物感到厌倦后，为了消遣而杀人。

sentences.en: The decoded cipher was published, and people soon started coming forward claiming they could help decipher the garbled text at the end.
sentences.zh: 解码后的密码被公布后，人们很快开始站出来声称他们可以帮忙破译末尾的乱码。

sentences.en: One thought it might read,
sentences.zh: 有人认为它可能是：

sentences.en: One tipster informed the police that the killer's reference to accumulating slaves for the afterlife was a spiritual concept found in parts of the Philippines,
sentences.zh: 一位线人通知警方，凶手提到为来世积累奴隶是菲律宾部分地区存在的一种精神概念，

sentences.en: and that the zodiac may have a connection to the area.
sentences.zh: 并且十二宫可能与该地区有联系。

sentences.en: All of these theories were investigated, but nothing came of them.
sentences.zh: 所有这些理论都得到了调查，但都没有结果。

sentences.en: Detectives were no closer to identifying a suspect, and fears grew that the zodiac could soon strike again.
sentences.zh: 侦探们距离确定嫌疑人并没有更近一步，人们越来越担心十二宫可能很快会再次袭击。

sentences.en: Almost three months later, rookie officer David Slate was manning the telephone switchboard of the Napa Police Department when a call came through at 7.40pm.
sentences.zh: 几乎三个月后，菜鸟警官大卫·斯莱特正在纳帕警察局的总机值班，晚上7点40分，一个电话打了进来。

sentences.en: A male voice was on the other line.
sentences.zh: 电话那头是一个男人的声音。

sentences.en: In a calm tone, he stated,
sentences.zh: 他用平静的语气说道：

sentences.en: I want to report a murder.
sentences.zh: “我要报告一起谋杀案。”

sentences.en: No, a double murder.
sentences.zh: “不，是一起谋杀双尸案。”

sentences.en: They are two miles north of park headquarters.
sentences.zh: “他们在公园总部以北两英里处。”

sentences.en: They were in a white Volkswagen Karmann gear.
sentences.zh: “他们在一辆白色的大众卡门吉亚里。”

sentences.en: Officer Slate thought the caller sounded young, as though he was in his early twenties.
sentences.zh: 斯莱特警官觉得打电话的人听起来很年轻，好像二十出头。

sentences.en: Trying to coax out more information, the officer asked the man where he was.
sentences.zh: 为了套出更多信息，警官问他在哪里。

sentences.en: In a quiet, barely audible voice, the caller simply replied,
sentences.zh: 打电话的人用平静、几乎听不见的声音简单回答道：

sentences.en: I'm the one who did it.
sentences.zh: “我就是凶手。”
